parties.respondent: National Highways Authority of India & Ors.

summary: Dispute over revision of BOQ rates for geogrid under NHAI contract; Arbitral Tribunal, DRB, and Single Judge upheld payment at original BOQ rates; Division Bench reversed under Section 37; Supreme Court examines scope of appellate review, concurrent findings, and interpretation of COPA Clauses 51, 52; limited jurisdiction under Section 37(1)(c) emphasized; challenge to interference with technical findings.
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of with directions; interim order on bank guarantee continued pending final determination.
